author: PunKing
quote:
We was anticipating a masterpiece, shame it turned out to be a dumpster fire instead. Removed convenient mechanics, made doing general gameplay loops within a GTA game feels non-existent, and not once did my characters feel they belonged as protagonists for a franchise like this. They feel more like a 'strangers and freaks' character encounter.

Gameplay: 2/10
Story: 1/10

The reason my review score is 1, is because graphics shouldn't be an excuse for a game to be 'good'. So despite it being quite aesthetically pleasing, I'm not going to review that section. Many games like Undertale's graphics are done with pixel art, but is an example of what I expect out of a videogame. GTA 6 is a disappointment.
